items.title: Initialise and install
items.description: Start a project and add dependencies.

items.title: Clean install from the lockfile
items.body: npm ci
items.description: Reproducible install for CI (deletes node_modules first).

items.title: package.json scripts
items.description: Typical script block; run with npm run <name>.

items.title: Run scripts and pass arguments
items.body:
npm run build
npm test
npm run dev -- --port 3000
items.description: Arguments after -- go to the script itself.

items.title: npx: run a package without installing
items.description: Execute a CLI from the registry or from node_modules/.bin.

items.title: Manage Node versions with nvm
items.body:
nvm install --lts
nvm install 20
nvm use 20
nvm ls
nvm alias default 20
echo "20" > .nvmrc && nvm use     # per-project version
items.description: Install and switch Node versions.

items.title: Check outdated and update
items.body:
npm outdated
npm update
npm ls --depth=0
npm view {{package}} versions
items.description: See what can be upgraded.

items.title: Audit dependencies
items.body:
npm audit
npm audit fix
items.description: Report and fix known vulnerabilities.

items.title: Semver ranges
items.body:
1.2.3     exactly 1.2.3
^1.2.3    >=1.2.3 <2.0.0 (minor and patch updates)
~1.2.3    >=1.2.3 <1.3.0 (patch updates only)
>=1.2.3   at least
*         anything
items.description: What the prefixes in package.json mean.

items.title: Bump version and tag
items.body:
npm version patch     # 1.0.0 -> 1.0.1
npm version minor     # -> 1.1.0
npm version major     # -> 2.0.0
items.description: Update package.json, commit and create a git tag.

items.title: Node one-liners
items.body:
node -e "console.log(process.version)"
node --watch app.js                # restart on change (Node 18.11+)
node --env-file=.env app.js        # load env vars (Node 20.6+)
items.description: Quick checks and watch mode.

items.title: Enable ES modules
items.description: Use import/export in .js files.

items.title: Fix: EADDRINUSE (port already in use)
items.body:
lsof -i :3000          # note the PID
kill {{pid}}
items.description: Find and stop whatever holds the port.

items.title: Fix: ERESOLVE could not resolve dependency tree
items.body: npm install --legacy-peer-deps
items.description: Peer dependency conflict: prefer fixing versions; this is the last resort.

items.title: Fix: Cannot find module / broken node_modules
items.body:
rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json
npm install
# or, keeping the lockfile:
rm -rf node_modules && npm ci
items.description: Start from a clean install.

items.title: Fix: EACCES on global installs
items.body:
npm config set prefix ~/.npm-global
export PATH=~/.npm-global/bin:$PATH
items.description: Avoid sudo by using a version manager or a user-level prefix.

items.title: Fix: ENOSPC file watchers limit (Linux)
items.body:
echo fs.inotify.max_user_watches=524288 | sudo tee -a /etc/sysctl.conf
sudo sysctl -p
items.description: Raise the inotify watch limit for dev servers.

items.title: Fix: digital envelope routines unsupported
items.body: export NODE_OPTIONS=--openssl-legacy-provider
items.description: Old webpack on Node 17+; upgrade the tool, or as a stopgap:

items.title: Fix: Cannot use import statement outside a module
items.body:
# Option 1: in package.json add  "type": "module"
# Option 2: rename the file to .mjs
# Option 3: use require() instead of import
items.description: Mixed ESM/CommonJS: set the module type or rename the file.

items.title: Clear the npm cache
items.body: npm cache clean --force
items.description: Last resort for corrupted installs.
